seoTitle: Delete a Domain on Hostinger (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Remove an unused domain from your Hostinger account through hPanel, with a confirmation step to prevent accidental deletion.
intro: Cleaning up your Hostinger account by removing an unused domain keeps your dashboard organized and makes room for new projects. This guide covers navigating to your domain list in hPanel and deleting the one you no longer need.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Go to the Hostinger website, click the login button, and enter your email and password.

steps.heading: Open hPanel
steps.body: From the homepage, find the hPanel link to reach Hostinger's central control panel for managing your account.

steps.heading: Go to the Websites section
steps.body: Within hPanel, locate the Websites section, where all your website-related services are organized.

steps.heading: Find the domain and open its options
steps.body: Scan the list for the specific domain you want to delete, then click on it to see the available management actions.

steps.heading: Delete and confirm
steps.body: Click Delete, then confirm the action when prompted to permanently remove the domain from your account.

faq.question: Is deleting a domain in Hostinger reversible?
faq.answer: The confirmation prompt exists specifically to prevent accidental deletions — once confirmed, the domain is removed and you'd need to re-add it manually to restore it.

faq.question: Where do I manage all my domains in Hostinger?
faq.answer: The Websites section within hPanel lists all websites and domains linked to your account.

faq.question: Should I double-check anything after deleting a domain?
faq.answer: Yes, it's wise to confirm the domain no longer appears in your list to avoid confusion later.

faq.question: Does deleting a domain also delete its email accounts?
faq.answer: Domain and email data are closely tied in Hostinger, so removing a domain can affect associated email accounts — back up anything important first.
